title: DARK BEIGE BACKGROUND, NOT IVORY.
text: DARK BEIGE BACKGROUND, NOT IVORY.. I fully expect to LOVE the hall runner I purchased with plans on purchasing the larger sizes for my living room. I wasn't prepared for the dark DARK beige background, expecting an IVORY background as stated. Thankfully I just bought the hall runner and I'll keep it, but I won't be purchasing the larger area rug for my living room.

product_metadata.title: SAFAVIEH Bergama Collection 8' x 10' Light Green / Beige BRG166B Handmade French Country Premium Wool Area Rug
features: The handmade, hand-tufted construction adds durability to this rug, ensuring it will be a favorite for many years.
Each rug is handmade with plush, premium wool.
This traditional rug will give your room an elegant accent
For over 100 years, Safavieh has been crafting rugs of the higest quality and unmatched style
description: The Safavieh Bergama Collection includes beautiful reproductions of antique, Peshawar rugs. Each rug is handmade and hand-tufted rugs of the finest quality. Plush, 100-percent pure wool is chosen to achieve the intricate weave of these magnificent carpets. With utmost attention to every detail, Safavieh creates its Bergama Collection in India to provide consumers an exquisite yet affordable artisan-crafted look. Made in India, the pure wool rugs in this collection recreate the design and quality of Peshawars made for the top end of the market to a broader base of customers with superior hand tufted quality.

details.Warranty Description: Safavieh warranty is 30 days from the seller, and 90 days from the manufacturer. The wool warranty by safavieh for this bergama collection rug is 1 year.
